objections: The geoip table includes Meridian's own ranges: 'Meridian Logistics Oy', 'Meridian Logistics Oy (warehouses)' and 'Meridian internal' (10.0.0.0/8). Keeping organisation verbatim tells competitors Meridian's corporate and warehouse address blocks, which is internal network layout the threat model puts out of scope.

No utility task needs the owner name: the required IoCs are the attacker IPs themselves, and community members can look up hosting/ISP ownership from their own geoIP/ASN data. Rare-merge is not a middle ground here because every value occurs at most twice, so it collapses the column anyway.
